paths.guide: Brand Identity/Fresh Port Brand Identity Guide.md
paths.instagram: 35 Instagram posts in the brand folder (1080 × 1350): colours sampled from flat areas, shapes traced from the posts
paths.logo: Fresh Port copy.pdf (4 pages) and Fresh Port (แบบวงกลม) copy.pdf (2 pages): official Illustrator artwork
paths.website: Shopify theme 'Fresh Port Landing — SEO + navy favicon' (live): assets/fresh-port.css, assets/fp-motion.css, sections/fp-*.liquid, snippets/fp-icon.liquid
paths.business_profile: Shopify page 'business-profile' (layout deck): Files fpd-src-fp-deck-css.txt, fpd-src-body-html.txt

meta.github: vegastrp47-design/freshport: not reachable (private or missing), not synced

tokens.name: night-deep
tokens.usage: Night Deep. Deepest shadow, footers, overlays on photos.

tokens.name: midnight-blue
tokens.usage: Midnight Blue, the signature colour (HEX #112331, RGB 17/35/49, CMYK 65/29/0/81 official). The primary logo ground, the Instagram corner tab and the first line of every post headline. Backgrounds, headings, signage, uniforms.

tokens.name: harbour-navy
tokens.usage: Harbour Navy. Cards and panels on navy backgrounds.

tokens.name: deep-sea
tokens.usage: Deep Sea. Hover state of navy buttons, dividers on navy, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: gold-light
tokens.usage: Gold Light. Soft highlights; gold text on navy at small sizes.

tokens.name: harbour-gold
tokens.usage: Harbour Gold, the premium accent. Thin rules, seals, eyebrows and key numbers on navy (7.9:1 on midnight-blue). Never text on white (2:1). About 5% of a layout with the fruit accents.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Gold Deep. Gold on light backgrounds: large display text and lines only (about 3:1 on white). Foil reference.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: White. Main light background, product backgrounds, text on navy (16:1 on midnight-blue).

tokens.name: sea-mist
tokens.usage: Sea Mist. Cool light section background on the website; icon tiles.

tokens.name: sail-cream
tokens.usage: Sail Cream. Warm paper background for print and decks.

tokens.name: crate-pine
tokens.usage: Crate Pine. The natural pine of the crates and kiosk: wood surfaces, kraft packaging. A surface, not a text colour.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Slate. Secondary text on white, sea-mist and sail-cream (5.5:1 on white).

tokens.name: fruit-cherry
tokens.usage: Cherry red from the Instagram posts: the fruit word and price blob on Chile Cherry, Washington Cherry, Red Grape and Fuji Apple. White price text 8.2:1.

tokens.name: fruit-apple-red
tokens.usage: Apple red: price blobs on Red Grape and Envy Apple. White text 6.1:1.

tokens.name: fruit-apple-bright
tokens.usage: Bright apple red: price blobs on Sugar Bee and Jazz Apple. White text 6.1:1.

tokens.name: fruit-strawberry
tokens.usage: Strawberry red: fruit word and price circle on Arihyang and Pink Candy Strawberry. White text 5.3:1.

tokens.name: fruit-rose-apple
tokens.usage: Deep red of the word 'Rose Apple'. White text 7.1:1.

tokens.name: fruit-rose-apple-blob
tokens.usage: Coral red of the Rose Apple price blob. White price text 4.3:1 (passes at price sizes, 24px+).

tokens.name: fruit-sweet-potato
tokens.usage: Raspberry of the word 'Shitori' (sweet potato). White text 6.2:1.

tokens.name: fruit-grape-green
tokens.usage: Olive green: word and price blob on Ivory Grape. White text 6.8:1.

tokens.name: fruit-leaf-green
tokens.usage: Leaf green of the words 'Guava' and 'Mango'. White text 8.6:1.

tokens.name: fruit-sage
tokens.usage: Sage: price blobs on Avocado (Hass) and Green Mango. White price text 3.3:1: large text only.

tokens.name: fruit-blueberry
tokens.usage: Blueberry blue: price blob on Blueberry. White text 7.1:1.

tokens.name: fruit-persimmon
tokens.usage: Persimmon brown: word 'Persimmon' and 'Pear' (Emerald Pear), price blobs on Persimmon, Chinese Jumbo Pear and Durian Chip. White price text 4.0:1 (large text).

tokens.name: fruit-orange
tokens.usage: Orange: second price blob on Envy Apple (4-pack). The posts put white text on it (2.1:1, below 3:1). Midnight-blue text reads 7.8:1.

tokens.name: fruit-pear
tokens.usage: Pale pear gold: price blob on Emerald Pear. The posts put white text on it (1.8:1, below 3:1). Midnight-blue text reads 8.8:1.

tokens.name: fruit-plum
tokens.usage: Amber: word 'Plum' and price blob on Marian Plum. The posts put white text on it (2.6:1, below 3:1). Midnight-blue text reads 6.1:1.

tokens.name: fruit-yellow
tokens.usage: Yellow: price blob on Shitori. The posts put white text on it (1.6:1, below 3:1). Midnight-blue text reads 10.3:1.

tokens.name: price-navy
tokens.usage: Slate navy price blob on Mandarin Orange. White text 12:1.

tokens.name: price-secondary
tokens.usage: Dark charcoal circle for the second (bundle) price, e.g. '1,800.- for 4 packs'. White text 11.5:1.

tokens.name: price-promo
tokens.usage: Warm brown tag for promotions like '3 แถม 1'. White text 5.2:1.

tokens.name: stripe-cherry
tokens.usage: Pastel stripe under the navy corner tab on Chile Cherry, Fuji Apple, Washington Cherry. Decorative only; never text.

tokens.name: stripe-apple
tokens.usage: Pastel stripe under the navy corner tab on Sugar Bee, Jazz, Red Grape, Envy Apple. Decorative only; never text.

tokens.name: stripe-washington-cherry
tokens.usage: Pastel stripe under the navy corner tab on Washington Cherry (dark). Decorative only; never text.

tokens.name: stripe-strawberry
tokens.usage: Pastel stripe under the navy corner tab on Pink Candy Strawberry. Decorative only; never text.

tokens.name: stripe-rose-apple
tokens.usage: Pastel stripe under the navy corner tab on Rose Apple. Decorative only; never text.

tokens.name: stripe-sweet-potato
tokens.usage: Pastel stripe under the navy corner tab on Shitori. Decorative only; never text.

tokens.name: stripe-grape
tokens.usage: Pastel stripe under the navy corner tab on Ivory Grape. Decorative only; never text.

tokens.name: stripe-guava
tokens.usage: Pastel stripe under the navy corner tab on Guava. Decorative only; never text.

tokens.name: stripe-mango
tokens.usage: Pastel stripe under the navy corner tab on Green Mango. Decorative only; never text.

tokens.name: stripe-avocado
tokens.usage: Pastel stripe under the navy corner tab on Avocado (Hass). Decorative only; never text.

tokens.name: stripe-blueberry
tokens.usage: Pastel stripe under the navy corner tab on Blueberry. Decorative only; never text.

tokens.name: stripe-persimmon
tokens.usage: Pastel stripe under the navy corner tab on UKIHA Persimmon. Decorative only; never text.

tokens.name: stripe-mandarin
tokens.usage: Pastel stripe under the navy corner tab on Mandarin Orange. Decorative only; never text.

tokens.name: stripe-plum
tokens.usage: Pastel stripe under the navy corner tab on Marian Plum. Decorative only; never text.

tokens.name: stripe-durian
tokens.usage: Pastel stripe under the navy corner tab on Durian Chip. Decorative only; never text.

tokens.name: stripe-pear
tokens.usage: Pastel stripe under the navy corner tab on Emerald Pear. Decorative only; never text.

tokens.name: stripe-jumbo-pear
tokens.usage: Pastel stripe under the navy corner tab on Chinese Jumbo Pear. Decorative only; never text.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and section ground. Website: white. Navy: midnight-blue sections and navy slides. Profile cream: the business profile's light slides.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate band: sea-mist on the website (fruit grid, FAQ), night-deep under navy, white panels on cream slides.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, product tiles, format cards and panels sitting on surface or surface-alt.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: A block in the opposite theme: the navy 'Why it matters' panel or highlighted format card on a light page or cream slide.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on surface, surface-alt and surface-raised (14:1+ website, 16:1 navy, 14.6:1 cream).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, ledes, card meta and captions on surface and surface-raised (5.5:1 website, about 11:1 navy, 5.0:1 cream).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: eyebrow
tokens.usage: Eyebrow labels. Website: slate. Navy: harbour-gold (7.9:1). Profile cream: gold-deep, as the deck sets it (2.8:1 on cream: only at 20px medium and up, never for body text).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Gold accent for 1px rules, timeline fills, check icons, seals and key numbers. Website: gold-deep, lines and display text only. Navy: harbour-gold. Cream: gold-deep.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders: chips, outline buttons, dividers, card borders (the business profile uses a slightly lighter .14 white on navy).

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet card and step borders on surface.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill (pill).

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an action fill.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 3px focus outline, offset 3px, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The coloured half of a two-tone headline and the italic English sub-line (profile-en). Navy slides: harbour-gold (7.9:1). Cream slides: gold-deep, display sizes only (2.8:1). The website keeps headlines one colour, so it stays midnight-blue there.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a harbour-gold fill: the PROVEN and SIGNATURE badges, the 'Coming soon' status, the gold number node (7.9:1).

tokens.name: line-gold
tokens.usage: Gold hairline: the cover chip on navy, the active slide-nav pill, note boxes on cream.

tokens.name: surface-glass
tokens.usage: Translucent tiles on a photo or navy: KPI tiles, contact rows, market pills (with line). Pair with line for the edge.

tokens.name: status-open
tokens.usage: The live dot in the 'Open' status pill. A marker, never text; always with the word.

families.headline: "DM Serif Text", "DM Serif Display", Georgia, serif

styles.name: display-hero
styles.sample: Straight from the port to our shelf.
styles.usage: H1 and hero headline, English only. Scales down to 40px on phones (clamp 40px to 68px). Put a Thai line in thai-sub under it.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings (clamp 30px to 46px).

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Feature and partner names, campaign sub-titles (clamp 22px to 30px).

styles.name: fruit-name
styles.usage: Fruit and grower names on cards. On social: first word in ink, fruit word in its fruit-* accent.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: The port is our gateway to the best of each season.
styles.usage: Pull quote in the story section, 3px midnight-blue left rule, 18px left padding.

styles.name: step-number
styles.usage: Big step numbers on step cards, midnight-blue at 16% opacity.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Set UPPERCASE, colour eyebrow. Above headings.

styles.name: thai-sub
styles.sample: ส่งตรงจากท่าเรือ สู่ชั้นวางของเรา
styles.usage: Thai line directly under an English section heading (site class fp-th): Prompt Light, ink-muted, clamp 15.5px to 18px.

styles.name: hero-thai
styles.sample: ร้านผลไม้นำเข้าคุณภาพพรีเมียม คัดสรรผลไม้สดจากแหล่งปลูกทั่วโลก
styles.usage: Thai line under the hero headline, Prompt Light, 18px of space above it (clamp 17px to 21px).

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Point, step and highlight titles (18px); fruit card names run 16.5px.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Premium imported fruit, carefully selected from around the world.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a section heading, ink-muted, max 58ch.

styles.name: faq-question
styles.sample: ที่ร้านมีผลไม้อะไรบ้าง?
styles.usage: FAQ question (Thai first), with the English question under it in caption weight 300.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Over 80% of what we sell is imported by our own family business. นำเข้าเอง คัดเอง
styles.usage: Body copy, English and Thai. Thai needs the tall line height.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Card and step text, footer links.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels; 14.5px on small buttons.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices, always followed by a unit line in caption. Grow to 64px on posters.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Units, Thai card names, origins, footer small print.

styles.name: label-caps
styles.usage: Footer column headings and origin tags, UPPERCASE.

styles.name: profile-cover-title
styles.sample: ประตูสู่ผลไม้พรีเมียม
styles.usage: Cover and closing slide headline on a 1920 × 1080 slide, Thai first. The second line takes highlight.

styles.name: profile-title
styles.sample: ผ่านมือน้อยกว่า · สดกว่า · คุ้มกว่า
styles.usage: Slide headline, Prompt SemiBold. Split with ' · ' or break to a second line in highlight.

styles.name: profile-en
styles.sample: Fewer hands between the orchard and the shelf.
styles.usage: English line under a Thai headline: DM Serif Display Italic in highlight (42px on the cover).

styles.name: profile-eyebrow
styles.sample: 02  เรื่องราวของเรา  WHO WE ARE
styles.usage: Slide eyebrow in eyebrow colour: a 44px outlined circle with the slide number in DM Serif Display, the Thai label, then the English label in 15px caps at .14em and 75% opacity.

styles.name: profile-sub
styles.sample: เราไม่ใช่สตาร์ทอัพที่ต้อง “เดา” เรื่องแหล่งสินค้า
styles.usage: Slide body text in ink-muted.

styles.name: profile-card-title
styles.sample: Fresh Port สาขาแรก HomePro
styles.usage: Card and timeline headings (22px to 32px by card size).

styles.name: profile-label
styles.usage: UPPERCASE role and format labels above card titles, in accent.

styles.name: profile-stat
styles.usage: The single hero number on the cover, harbour-gold with the gold sheen (see README). One per slide at most.

styles.name: profile-kpi
styles.usage: KPI tile numbers in harbour-gold (40px for timeline years, 30px for sizes like 30–40 ตร.ม.).

styles.name: ig-headline
styles.usage: Post headline line 1 on a 1080 × 1350 post, in midnight-blue. DM Serif Text with a faux-bold stroke of 0.036em in the text colour (Canva 'Bold' on a one-weight font). About 110–130px.

styles.name: ig-headline-fruit
styles.usage: Post headline line 2: the fruit word, larger than line 1, in its fruit-* colour, same faux-bold stroke. About 130–155px.

styles.name: ig-thai-pill
styles.sample: เชอร์รี่ ชิลี
styles.usage: Thai fruit name in the outlined pill under the headline: Prompt Light, midnight-blue, pill 1px midnight-blue stroke, full radius, about 150 × 41px.

styles.name: ig-price
styles.usage: Price in the price blob: Poppins Bold, white, always written '280.-'.

styles.name: ig-unit
styles.usage: Unit line under the price: Poppins Regular, white, in brackets, e.g. '(1 Pack, 4 ลูก)'.

styles.name: ig-handle
styles.usage: '@freshport' in the LINE pill: Poppins Regular, midnight-blue.

styles.name: ig-stamp
styles.usage: Arched text on the origin stamp (at a 200px stamp), DM Serif Text with the faux-bold stroke. Use the stamp files rather than re-setting it.

tokens.name: space-2xs
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in chips and badges.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: button icon, list items.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Grid gaps inside cards; ripple-line pitch.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; branch card padding.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Button side padding; card padding.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter (clamp 16px to 40px).

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Vertical section padding on desktop (clamp 60px to 104px).

tokens.name: slide-margin
tokens.usage: Left and right margin of every business-profile slide (1920 × 1080).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Skip link, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: Icon tiles (44 to 46px squares).

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Business profile tags, photo insets and QR cards' inner tiles.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, branch boxes, partner tiles.

tokens.name: radius-slide-card
tokens.usage: Business profile cards: formats, stores, the 'why it matters' panel (26px).

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Large panels, feature images, the visit block.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, badges, the LINE pill, ripple lines.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Icon buttons, dots, the origin stamp.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards and steps. Always navy-tinted, never grey or black.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Feature images, the visit panel, cards on hover.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The highlights bar overlapping the hero.

tokens.name: shadow-hover
tokens.usage: Buttons on hover (with a 2px lift).

tokens.name: shadow-card-profile
tokens.usage: Resting cards on cream slides (format cards, social panel).

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Profile cards on hover, lifted 8px.

tokens.name: shadow-gold
tokens.usage: Glow under a gold node or badge on navy.

tokens.name: shadow-header
tokens.usage: The sticky navy header once the page scrolls.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width, plus gutters.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Button min-height.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small button and icon-button size.

tokens.name: icon-tile
tokens.usage: Square icon tiles on steps and points.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Navy website header (64px under 900px); logo 44px tall (36px on mobile).

tokens.name: slide-width
tokens.usage: Business profile slide canvas width (1080px tall).

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Line icons inside 44 to 46px tiles; 18px in buttons, 14px beside small text.
